programmes.t: Secret War: Double Agent Tricycle
programmes.d: Dusan Popov was almost certainly James Bond. Ian Fleming knew all the stories about him. Popov managed to persuade both the Germans and MI6 to keep him in the style of a millionaire businessman while performing a series of missions against the Nazis.

programmes.t: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Italy: Operation Galia
programmes.d: Monty’s journey sees him follow the path 33 SAS soldiers took after they were parachuted behind enemy lines to attack the enemy and create chaos to draw Nazi-fascist forces away from the front line.

programmes.t: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Time is Blood 1942-5
programmes.d: Episode 2 begins after the desperate German winter of 1941. Yet 1942 began badly for the Soviets, with more vicious Nazi campaigning seeing millions more Russians captured and starved.

programmes.t: Weapons That Changed the World
programmes.d: The Colt M1911, designed by John Moses Browning, is the 20th century's most influential pistol. Its .45 ACP cartridge made it the U.S. military's standard for 75 years. Wil Willis tests it to explore its stopping power.

programmes.t: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Slovenia: The Crow's Flight
programmes.d: Monty heads to Slovenia to retrace one of the most daring, yet unknown, mass escapes of Allied prisoners during the second world war, made possible only with the help of partisans and locals.

programmes.t: Secret War: The Dutch Disaster
programmes.d: Operation North Pole was a WWII German deception using captured SOE agents to mislead Britain. 47 of 50 agents were captured. Despite warnings, SOE ignored signs of compromise to maintain support, leading to a major intelligence failure.

programmes.t: Hitler's Mega Plane: Hitler's Mega Plane
programmes.d: In January 2012, Italian divers discovered the wreck of a massive plane off the coast of Sardinia. At a depth of 65 meters (213 feet) lies a Messerschmidt “Gigant”.

programmes.t: Nazi Collaborators: Vidkun Quisling
programmes.d: Vidkun Quisling, once honored for diplomacy, turned traitor by collaborating with Nazis. His bid for power in Norway failed, relegated by Germans. Despite being named "fuehrer," his reign led to repression until his hanging post-Nazi defeat.

programmes.t: World War II in HD Colour: The Mediterranean and North Africa
programmes.d: Italy's failed attacks in the Mediterranean region draw in the Germans.

programmes.t: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Preparing for War
programmes.d: Hitler unveils his military plans: annex Austria, seize the Sudetenland, and eventually invade Poland and the Soviet Union. By March 1938, Austria falls bloodlessly. By September 1939, he invades Poland, sparking World War Two.

programmes.t: Weapons That Changed the World
programmes.d: The AK-47, the world's deadliest firearm, sparked a Cold War race for superior assault rifles like the American M4 and German HK 416. Host Wil Willis explores its history, from Mikhail Kalashnikov's WWII experiences to its assembly and lethal impact.

programmes.t: Nazi Collaborators: The Arajs Kommando
programmes.d: Viktor Arajs, a Latvian, played a significant role in the Holocaust, collaborating with the Nazis to eliminate Jews. Leading the Arajs Kommando, he orchestrated the killings of around 30,000 Jews. Arajs justified his actions as patriotic defense.

programmes.t: Secret War: The Special Interrogation Group
programmes.d: The SIG consisted of German speaking Jewish volunteers from Palestine. They had a highly dangerous job: which was to pose as Germans behind enemy lines and extract intelligence and do acts of sabotage. Few had a long-life expectancy.

programmes.t: Battle Of Dunkirk
programmes.d: I en kapplöpning med tiden korsade över 800 privata båtar Engelska kanalen för att rädda de förlistade soldaterna från infernot på Dunkerques stränder. Se enskilda veteraners extraordinära hjältemod i ett slag som förändrade andra världskrigets gång.

programmes.t: Secret War: The French Triple Agent
programmes.d: Operation Cockade, led by MI6's double agent Henri Dericourt in 1943, aimed to deceive Germans with sabotage. Despite efforts, Germans withdrew divisions unconvinced. Dericourt faced a post-war treason trial and died in a mysterious 1962 plane crash.

programmes.t: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Misfits Gather
programmes.d: Hitler finds his political destiny in post-war Munich. He quickly dominates a fringe party & builds it into the Nazi Party. He recruits infamous men to the cause including Herman Goering & Heinrich Himmler & they plot a coup known as the Beerhall Putsch.

programmes.t: Nazi Collaborators: The Belgian Collaborator
programmes.d: Leon Degrelle, a charismatic Belgian leader, joined the Nazis and led Die Wallonien on the Eastern Front. Despite no military background, he earned the Knight's Cross for valor. He recruited 4000 more for the SS, defending Berlin until April 1945.

programmes.t: Secret War: The Mafia Connection
programmes.d: Lucky Luciano, a mafia boss of the 1930s, was in jail in 1942 on charges of running prostitution rings. US intelligence services did a deal with him and he got the Italians to share intelligence on German U boat movements.

programmes.t: Weapons That Changed the World
programmes.d: Special Forces operate deep behind enemy lines with top-of-the-line weapons.Host Wil Willis tests the Sig Sauer P226, the preferred choice like the Mark 25 by Navy SEALs, against competitors like the H&K Compact Tactical.

programmes.t: Secret War: Hardy Amies and Operation Ratweek
programmes.d: Operation Ratweek’s existence has always been denied. However WMR has now discovered evidence that it existed and was carried out.

programmes.t: Weapons That Changed the World
programmes.d: Host Wil Willis tests the Garand against the Arisaka Type 99, showcasing its impact in WWII and sniper rifles' deadly precision, from Carlos Hathcock to Craig Harrison. Witness the historic rifles that shaped warfare!

programmes.t: Secret War: The Banker, the Norwegians & the Bomb
programmes.d: Sir Charles attended Eton, and then joined the Coldstream Guards. He won the Military Cross on the Western Front and, having survived the war, returned to banking.

programmes.t: Nazi Collaborators: The Croatian Collaborator
programmes.d: Croatia grapples with its fascist past through figures like Dinko Sakic, once hailed as a hero but later convicted of war crimes. Leading the notorious Jasenovac camp, Sakic oversaw brutal atrocities against inmates.

programmes.t: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Final Solution
programmes.d: This is the story of how Hitler orchestrated the genocide of 6 million Jews. Hitler portrayed Jews as a societal threat, using Goebbels' propaganda. Deportations were masked as resettlements while Auschwitz-Birkenau became a death factory.
